code_first.code:
sizeMb = 48
rateMbps = 12
timeSeconds = sizeMb DIV rateMbps
print(timeSeconds)
p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Explain why actual time might be longer.
code_first.a: 4 s; 6 s; protocol overhead, latency or congestion.

original_exam_questions: Explain the difference between bandwidth and latency. [2 marks]
Bandwidth is data capacity per unit time; latency is delay before response/transfer.
Calculate time for a 40 Mb file over 10 Mb/s ideal link. [2 marks]
Give two factors reducing Wi-Fi performance. [2 marks]
Interference, weak signal/distance, number of users or obstacles.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: Transfer time uses file size divided by transfer rate, with compatible units.

stretch.task: Adapt the program to include 2 seconds of fixed latency in the predicted time.
stretch.hint: Add latency to the transfer time, rather than changing the rate.

mastery.task: Write a transfer-time function that rejects zero/negative speed and compares two connection rates, including fixed latency.
mastery.answer: For 48Mb at 12Mbps with 2s latency ->6s; at 8Mbps ->8s. Zero speed must not cause division by zero.
